Problem Statement:
Write a Java program to check whether a given number is Even or Odd. 
Input Description:
The program should accept a single integer N as input. 
Output Description:
The program should print "Even" if N is divisible by 2.
The program should print "Odd" if N is not divisible by 2. 
Sample Input:
4 
Sample Output:
Even
